messages:
ada: Quick announcement — were opening a gated preview for H100v4 Dedicated pools in Vancouver (yvr) and Zurich (zrh) next Wednesday 09:00 local. Pilot customers only, limited capacity.

raul: Whats the fairness model? Any hard caps per-tenant?

ada: Fairshare applied. New per-tenant cap of 20% of pool capacity and a soft burst allowance (10% additional for 10m) to reduce thundering-herd issues.

nina: Ops note: Maintenance window planned Sun 02:00-03:00 local for kernel upgrades. Private customers must upgrade runtime 4.2+ before we route traffic.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/h100v4-preview (internal) :link:

finance: Billing: preview discounted at 55% of GA list. No SLA during preview; normal SLA applies once GA. We will tag preview usage as "h100v4_preview" for cost breakdowns.

ada: Migration tips: start with tiny canaries, enable prefix caching, set request_timeouts to 90s for long-context models. We will fallback to H100v3 when needed. DM me for pilot nominations. :rocket:
